history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: there is no known Barfani Dham in Raigarh. The famous Barfani Dham (Patal Bhairavi) is in the town of Rajnandgaon in Rajnandgaon district, about 40 km from Durg towards Nagpur. Documented here with the corrected location; correct or drop the CSV row. The temple is a modern, newly-built three-level structure: the bottom level houses the Patal Bhairavi shrine, the middle level the Navadurga/Tripura Sundari shrine, and the top level a large Shiva linga (one Chhattisgarh Tourism video describes it as 108 ft - verify) with a large Nandi statue in front. Wikipedia coordinates: 21.09278 N, 81.00611 E. Also known as Barfani Ashram, it is a significant Shaivite pilgrimage site in the region.

town_description: Rajnandgaon is a city in Chhattisgarh on the Durg-Nagpur corridor, headquarters of Rajnandgaon district (carved out of Durg district in 1973). It was once a princely state and is known today for the Barfani Dham temple and the nearby Dongargarh Bamleshwari temple.
